verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists "Custom ring orders", call transfers and phone menus, and the homepage claims it routes incoming calls to the right person on a shared team number. Voicemail capture for missed calls is evidenced, and Sona AI answers when the team can't. These are bare feature-list mentions without documentation of how they work. missing for 10: explicit simultaneous-ring option, documented fallback routing of unanswered calls to voicemail or an external number, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
